29.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks about. The description doesn't name the animal or where it lives, so treat Bret's request in game as your brief, and check the trophy listings if the target isn't obvious once you take the job.

30.guide: Collect cards until you can complete three full Collectible Card sets. The description doesn't say where cards are found or how big a set is, so pick up every card you spot while exploring and use the listings to confirm set sizes.

31.guide: 'WAiNK It' at 100 different locations. The description never explains what WAiNK is, so learn the action or spot type in game first, then work through locations across the state; trackers are the place to verify what counts toward the 100.

32.guide: Complete any 50 challenges. The description doesn't limit which challenges count, so mix story, activity and world challenges as you play and let the total build naturally rather than grinding one type.

33.guide: While your partner is with you, raise a four-star wanted level, then break line of sight and stay out of sight until the stars clear completely. Both conditions — partner present and a full escape from four stars — have to hold on the same attempt.

34.guide: With your partner along, rob three shops back-to-back while keeping your wanted level the whole time — if the heat fully drops between shops, the chain breaks and you start the count again. Pick shops close together and keep moving between them.

35.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. The description doesn't define what counts as discovering one, so get in, drive or closely encounter as many distinct models as you can across the state until the counter fills.

36.guide: Line up a crowded fight, trigger Combat Focus once, and take down five enemies before that single activation ends. Wait for a group rather than spending it on stragglers — all five have to fall inside the one use.

37.guide: Make an 'unscheduled departure' at VCIA. The description doesn't define what counts as one or when the chance comes, so if nothing obvious presents itself at VCIA, verify against the trophy listings before assuming you have missed it.

38.guide: The description is just a joke — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — and states no requirement at all. In series tradition a Rhino is a tank, so this likely involves one, but the wording alone doesn't establish what to do; check the trophy listings for the real condition.

39.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get through it without being detected. If you're spotted, that attempt is blown — leave, let things cool down and try again; nothing in the description says the chance is gone for good.

40.guide: Rob five bank vaults, escaping after each one. The description doesn't name the banks, so take vault robberies as you find them across Leonida and make sure each escape is clean before counting it toward the five.

41.guide: Find an armored truck, rob it and escape. One successful truck robbery with a clean getaway is all the description asks for.

42.guide: Explore the whole state of Leonida. The description doesn't say how exploration is measured, so travel every region and uncover the map fully instead of sticking to story locations.

43.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — one per gang, not the same gang twice. The description doesn't list the gangs or their operations, so identify each gang's operation as you encounter them across the state.

44.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description doesn't name the exact spot, so look for a beachfront bar or lounge along Ocean Beach and have a drink there.

45.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom — expect to drive out through the glass rather than use the door. What 'in classic style' adds isn't defined, so if a plain smash-out doesn't trigger it, check the listings for the expected flourish.

46.guide: The description only says 'Follow-through' at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley, without defining the act. Most plainly it means going there and bowling, but the wording alone doesn't establish whether a full game, a strike or something else counts — play a game there, and verify against the listings if it doesn't pop.

47.guide: The description — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — gives no action, place or number to work from, so there is no honest step-by-step to draw from the wording alone. Check the trophy listings for what this one actually tracks before trying to hunt it.

48.guide: This one is tied to choices you make, 'for better or worse', and story choices can't usually be unmade once the game moves on. Warning: keep a separate save before major story decisions so a choice that locks this out can be revisited, and check the listings for which decisions matter once they are known.

49.guide: 'Second time's the charm' means this is earned on a second attempt at something, not the first — a clean first-try success on a one-off event could pass it by entirely. Warning: keep a save before one-off events and story set pieces so you can reload, fail or miss deliberately, and then take the second attempt.

50.guide: The description — 'What the hell just happened?' — is a reaction, not an instruction, and the name hints at something strange out in the world. Nothing actionable can be drawn from the wording, so keep exploring off the beaten path and check the listings for what event this records.

51.guide: Bowl a group over with a melee drive-by — swinging at people from a moving vehicle. The name 'Ten Pin' hints at ten targets, but the description doesn't state a number, so line up a crowd and verify the count against the listings if it doesn't trigger.

52.guide: Launder Marked Bills through your contacts until you've earned $250,000 that way. It's a cumulative total, so route marked bills to your contacts whenever you're holding them and let the amount build over time.

53.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Any shop spending counts toward the one pool, so ordinary buying as you play will get there eventually; big purchases just speed it up.

54.guide: Purchase every garage property available. The description doesn't say how many garages there are or what they cost, so keep cash in reserve and check property listings in game as new areas open up.

55.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The description doesn't say which vehicles qualify, so register vehicles as you acquire or drive them until ten are on the app.
